title: Tom Scream
blurb: The Tom scream — the shrieking AAAAH of cartoon history's most punished cat. Eighty years of Jerry-related disasters distilled into one wail. It's the perfect overreaction sound: stubbed toes, jump scares, seeing the electricity bill. The scream's vintage theatrical quality makes modern minor inconveniences feel like classic slapstick catastrophes.
origin: Tom's iconic scream from Tom and Jerry.
